How to find a mentor who
changes your life

1. Look one step ahead,
not ten

2. Ask a specific question,
not "be my mentor"

3. Do what they say.
Then report back.

4. Offer something back

Your time, your skills.

6. Arrive curious every time

Learn between meetings.

6. Arrive curious every time

Use a micro-learning app
like the Sophia app.
